gwt.given: a candidate property type of Nullable<DayOfWeek> (a nullable enum)
gwt.when: IsValidType is evaluated for that candidate type on a MapToSqlBigIntAttribute instance and, separately, on a MapToSqlIntAttribute instance
gwt.then: MapToSqlBigIntAttribute.IsValidType returns false while MapToSqlIntAttribute.IsValidType returns true for the identical candidate type, because only the Int/SmallInt/TinyInt predicates accept a nullable-enum underlying type and the BigInt predicate does not
